name: Volk
source: The age and true origin of the character are unknown. In Anton's dream, the Wolf has a frightening, animal appearance, his eyes glow brightly in the dark, his body is covered with thick wolf fur, there are many pointed fangs in his mouth, and only his hands with long cracked nails give out human features in the creature.
